Three facts about lighthouses:
1. The oldest known lighthouse, the Pharos of Alexandria, was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
2. Lighthouses use a Fresnel lens, invented by Augustin-Jean Fresnel in 1822, to focus light into a powerful beam visible from great distances.
3. Many lighthouses have been automated in the 20th century, leading to the widespread use of solar power and LED lights in modern installations.
